about: How Clarity writes a name, the same in the spec (clarity_spec::names, clarity_spec::code::hyphenated) and in the IDE (app/src/lib/names.ts, commandLine.ts). isCamelCase: a small letter, then letters and digits only (every lower-case name: parts, handlers, toasts, functions). camelCase: words split by anything but letters and digits, the first starting small and each next one capital, the rest as written; one that starts with a digit gets an n in front. hyphenated: a command as the command line types it, each capital a hyphen and a small letter, an underscore a hyphen.
